public_rationale: A positive adjusted-margin report was public before the post, so the public record was not devoid of supporting evidence. But that report does not independently establish profitability under an agreed inference-cost definition. The claim combines a financial assertion with an ambiguous demand for proof. The unspecified accounting basis and incomplete cost reconciliation prevent a definitive financial score.
limitations: The usable margin evidence is secondary reporting, not an accessible underlying financial disclosure.
Positive gross margins and company-wide losses can coexist.
This assessment does not treat training costs as inference expenses.
